tasks.subject: Task 1: simplify-path module (TDD)
tasks.description:

**Files:** Create scripts/lib/simplify-path.mjs; Test scripts/lib/simplify-path.test.mjs

**Acceptance Criteria:** flattener M/L/H/V/C/S/Q/T/Z + arc throws; DP endpoint/collinear semantics; emitD no error accumulation + z on closed; 8/8 tests.

tasks.subject: Task 2: integrate into build-plates + regenerate
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Rebuild all plates at SIMPLIFY_TOLERANCE=0.2 (~3× smaller, ~7× fewer vertices, registration preserved).

**Files:** Modify scripts/build-plates.mjs (knob + map after parsePaths; remove dead flattenPath); regenerate public/images/plates/*.svg.

**Acceptance Criteria:** simplify once post-parsePaths; plates ≤900KB and ≤100k cmds; flattenPath gone; registration light[0]==dark[0] + glow⊂plate; jest 32/32; build 8/8.

**Verify:** node scripts/build-plates.mjs && npm run build && npx jest

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/build-plates.mjs", "public/images/plates/"], "verifyCommand": "node scripts/build-plates.mjs && npm run build && npx jest", "acceptanceCriteria": ["once post-parsePaths", "≤900KB ≤100k cmds", "flattenPath removed", "registration", "jest+build green"]}
```
